**Ruling status — GATE 0 PASSED (PI, 2026-07-29)**: decisions 1–4
approved as proposed; decision 6 approved with the generalise/cascade
instruction (landed, § 6); decision 5 approved after verification of
the § 4.3 figures, with headroom — **cross-model spend capped at

programme total Sol API cost, absolute worst case (§ 4.3 aggregate)

claims.notes: [BATCH NOTE b062] Range 268–357 (batch start boundary firm at 268; 357 is EOF). Scope decisions logged per instrument rule 5, not silently: the GATE 0 decision numerals ("decisions 1–4", "decision 5/6", the PI's blockquote list "1. Approve" … "6. Approve") are item identifiers, not quantitative claims; likewise § references (§ 1.4, § 4.3, § 6, § 7), gate and phase labels (GATE 0/3, Phase 1/3), the 2026-07-29 dates, the commit hashes a1bd74f49 / a8dcbb5b6 / 2794539b8 / 2c354ca2e / df16d855a, and the model names gpt-5.6-sol and Claude Fable 5. That is the bulk of the gap between the plan's ~94 broad-regex spans and the 12 genuine claims here — this range is a ruling record, quoted PI turns, and a changelog. Cost figures in this range (US$150 cap, ~$120 worst case, ≤$10/≤$60 asks, $5–10/≤$21, $25–60) all trace to the § 4.3 cost model at lines 166–205, outside this batch's range and prose in any case; per instrument rule 2 (never anchor prose to prose) they are recorded anchor-unknown for triage to chase to the OpenAI pricing anchor in charter § 8 (external) or the charter § 10 ruling record. This claim: the US$150 cap is a PI ruling whose only in-repo records are prose (this document's § 8 verbatim turn at lines 318–319 and the charter § 10 ruling record in planning/audit-charter.md); the ~$120 restates the worst-case cell of the § 4.3 aggregate table (line 189, outside this batch's range). Approx marker kept verbatim per instrument v1.2 amendment 5.

claims.notes: § 1.4 of this document (lines 81–86, outside this batch's range) enumerates them as the errata register plus five tracking docs under docs/methodology/preregistration/. claims.claim_text:
3. **C3 extension**: approve adding runs/analyses/run-registry manifests
   (+890 field checks → 28,682 total).

total C3 field checks after the extension (passes + conditions + runs + analyses + registry)

claims.notes: Both values are row × field products summed over the manifest family; each carries its own expression per instrument v1.2 amendment 1 so neither is compared against the other's derivation. The fields-per-row multipliers (20 passes, 16 conditions, 16 runs, 15 analyses, 4 registry) are asserted in § 1.2's table at lines 39–43 — outside this batch's range and prose, hence carried as literals in the expressions rather than as operands; row counts are read mechanically from the manifests. 27,792 (the charter-settled passes+conditions component) appears inside the span as part of a parenthetical but is not quoted here as a separate value: it sits in the line 103 § 2 table row, outside this batch's range. No committed artefact carries a field-check total scalar — reports/verification/c3-rederivation/rederivation-report.json holds per-verdict counts, not a field-check census total.
